name: JTBD3 — Inactive users via list-users path
description: Admin read path via REST list-users (not Admin Insights). Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model should filter list-users on lastLogin before ~90 days ago to identify license-reclaim candidates. Note: never-signed-in accounts match a lastLogin:lt filter per tool contract — real inactive users are those with an actual older login. Read-only.
prompt: List users who last logged in before roughly 90 days ago, to identify license-reclaim candidates. Use the list-users tool with a lastLogin filter. Summarize candidates with name, site role, and last login. Do not modify any user.
